description: Move sessions older than 90 days to sessions/archive/ on zug_end_session or via a zug archive CLI command. Update sync-to-fly.sh to exclude sessions/archive from tar (local-only history). zug_get_recent_sessions already uses a limit param so it naturally skips old sessions. Keeps sync fast and hot data bounded regardless of total session count.
title: Archive sessions older than 90 days to sessions/archive/
